title: Do your MW dreams feel like you're stepping into someone else's timeline / life?

classification.question_topic: Whether Mall World dreams feel like stepping into someone else's life/timeline; dreamer experiencing confusion while others act like they know them and expect them to know their job/navigation; multiple identities/jobs within the same consistent world

meta.occupation_in_dream: different jobs (varies by dream/identity); feels like work
meta.initial_emotion: cloudy and confused; swept up into activity
meta.author_theory: Arrival feels like opening eyes into a fully formed reality; others act like they know the dreamer; dreamer suspects they are inhabiting different identities; same world described like in a dome/bubble

position.relative_to: described as a single consistent world

qualities.raw_description: “opened my eyes and found myself in a fully formed reality with people bustling around me”; “I get kind of swept up into the flow of the activity”; “it always feels like work”; “I know it's all the same world. (Like it's in a dome or bubble)”

boundaries.description: World described “like it's in a dome or bubble” (no edge/border interaction described).

interactions.description: Dreamer is swept into the flow of activity and has to figure out where they are and what they are supposed to be doing; difficulty getting from point A to B.

entities_involved.description: “people bustling around me… They all seem to know what's going on… where they need to go”

interactions.description: People encountered act like they know the dreamer and are frustrated that the dreamer doesn't know how to do their job or what's going on.

entities_involved.description: People who “act like they know ME… frustrated with me that I suddenly don't know how to do my job or get from point A to B”

interactions.description: Dreamer reports not seeing themselves clearly while in MW.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question/meta description of recurring MW arrival experience; no specific sub-locations (mall/store/school/etc.) or explicit routes described. ‘Point A to B’ is mentioned without concrete places. ‘Dome/bubble’ noted as a world-quality rather than an encountered boundary.
